Goal: One reader every scan uses, so RPC budgets, retries and sampling are proven once (B4).
Steps:
1. Read the epic doc §1–§7 and the modules named in the Context pack. Reuse them; do not copy their logic.
2. Implement pure functions over an injected Odoo client (the `client: Any` pattern in `app/suite_insights.py`); every Odoo read goes through `app/scans/reader.py` when it exists (budget, retries, sampling).
3. Version differences come only from `app/compat/odoo_versions.py`; add a fact there only if this card's allow-list includes it.
4. Any model call goes through `app/ai_client` with `fence_fields(payload, source=...)`, and its output passes a deterministic validator before it is used (INV-13).
5. Unit tests use fake clients with 17/18/19/20 field names. No live Odoo in this card.
6. STOP-AND-ASK: a needed file is outside the allow-list; an AC is ambiguous or contradicts the epic doc; a check would need a non-`ingenium_` DB, a forbidden port (3002, 8001, 8002, 8012, 5433, 5436, 8069–8073, 11434), a git write, an outbound call to a third party, or a new dependency; an Odoo claim marked [Inferred] in the epic doc proves false on any of 17–20 (record it in the verify note, do not work around it); an oracle test looks wrong.
Acceptance criteria:
- AC1: Retries only transport errors and 5xx, 3 tries with 0.5/1/2 s backoff plus jitter (fake clock asserts the waits); 4xx is never retried.
- AC2: Calling `create`, `write`, `unlink` or any non-read method through the reader raises `ReadOnlyViolation` (allow-list of read methods: `search`, `search_count`, `read`, `search_read`, `read_group`, `fields_get`, `name_search`).
- AC3: Token bucket defaults to 4 calls/s per connection; a 429/503 from Odoo backs off and surfaces `RATE_LIMITED` with `retry_after_s`.
- AC4: Per-call timeout 20 s; when the scan budget is spent the reader returns what it has with `partial=True`; cancel is checked between calls.
- AC5: Samples cap at 5,000 rows per area and pages at 500 ids; a static test fails if any module under `app/scans/` other than `reader.py` calls `execute_kw`.
Decision table:

| Input / evidence | Expected |
|---|---|
| transport error twice then success | 3 calls, result returned |
| `write` through the reader | `ReadOnlyViolation`, no call sent |
| budget 2 s, 5 slow calls | partial=True with the completed areas |
